purpose: Open V2 SEALED exactly once after MODEL_S/M winner selection is frozen on V2 VAL.

phases.name: PLAN_AFTER_WINNER
phases.effect: Reads already-recorded archive metadata for 12 SEALED identities; deterministically selects one sequence and 3 frames; still does not extract pixels.

phases.name: MATERIALIZE_ONCE
phases.effect: Selectively extracts only 12 SEALED subjects, cam008/cam009, 3 synchronized frames; Final Reserve is excluded by assertion.

phases.name: GEOMETRY_QA
phases.effect: Registers Depth to RGB for cam008/cam009, creates trainer/eval-ready NPZ caches and contact sheets; requires the same winner hash.

phases.name: HUMAN_VISUAL_QA
phases.effect: Review every generated contact sheet; write status PASS_GROSS_VISUAL_REGISTRATION_REVIEW. No threshold/model selection may use SEALED.

phases.name: FREEZE_FIXED_EVALUATION_RULER
phases.effect: Freezes deterministic Camera-A evaluation point indices for 12 subjects x 3 frames and binds all comparator hashes.

phases.name: ONE_SHOT_EVALUATION
phases.effect: Evaluate Official, V2-TRAIN-only Txyz, frozen historical V1 E1, and frozen V2 winner using exactly the same manifest. Do not reselect winner or tune.

comparators.OFFICIAL: Official SAM3D Body checkpoint, hash-bound before evaluation
comparators.TRAIN_ONLY_TXYZ: Constant XYZ fit using V2 TRAIN subjects only
comparators.V2_WINNER: Frozen MODEL_S or MODEL_M checkpoint from V2 VAL selection

same_ruler_requirements: same deterministic registered Depth point indices
same absolute and translation-aligned metric implementations
failure_policy: Any checkpoint hash mismatch stops before SEALED planning/materialization.
Any Final Reserve identity overlap stops immediately.
Any geometry QA failure is reported; no subject replacement after SEALED opening.
SEALED results never alter training, threshold, sampling, metric, or winner selection.
